title: After years of teasing, the viral Nopia synth is 'basically finished'

paragraphs.text: The ‘harmony machine’ will be out by the end of the year for ‘around £550.’
paragraphs.translation: 這台「和聲機器」將於今年底上市,售價約 550 英鎊。

paragraphs.text: After setting the music gear corner of the internet on fire back in 2023 with the first glimpse at the Nopia, creators Martin Grieco and Rocío Gal are almost ready to bring it to market. The duo brought it to the MusicRadar offices for an in-depth first look and revealed that it will be launching in “a couple of months” for around £550.
paragraphs.translation: 2023 年,Nopia 首次亮相就在網路音樂器材圈掀起熱潮,如今創作者 Martin Grieco 與 Rocío Gal 終於即將把它推向市場。兩人將原型機帶到 MusicRadar 辦公室進行深度搶先體驗,並透露這款產品將在「幾個月內」上市,售價約 550 英鎊。

paragraphs.text: Nopia is built around harmonic interplay in a unique way. Rather than a few knobs and a keyboard controlling a single synth patch, it blends multiple modules — keys, bass, arp, and pad — into a single performance, not unlike a drumless groovebox. There’s a one-octave keyboard called the Chord Builder, a 12-button Tonal Selector, and an Extensions Dial that dictate the key and voicing of the chords. The idea is to let you play complex harmonies with just a finger or two.
paragraphs.translation: Nopia 以獨特的方式圍繞和聲互動打造而成。它並非用幾顆旋鈕與一個鍵盤來控制單一合成器音色,而是將鍵盤、貝斯、琶音器與 pad 等多個模組融合成一次演奏,有點像沒有鼓組的 groovebox(節奏製作機)。機身上有一個名為 Chord Builder 的單八度鍵盤、一個 12 按鍵的 Tonal Selector,以及一個 Extensions Dial,用來決定和弦的調性與聲位。其核心理念是讓使用者只用一兩根手指,就能彈奏出複雜的和聲。

paragraphs.text: Additional performance features include a strum plate in the top-right corner for plucking specific notes from a chord and a slider for full chord pitch bends.
paragraphs.translation: 其他演奏功能還包括位於右上角的 strum plate(刷弦板),可用來從和弦中挑出特定音符,以及一個能對整組和弦做音高彎音的滑桿。

paragraphs.text: In addition to the virtual analog and sample-based synth engines, there are basic effects like delay, reverb, tape emulation, and beat repeat, as well as a ton of connectivity options, including per-module MIDI output for controlling other instruments with Nopia’s harmonic engine.
paragraphs.translation: 除了虛擬類比與取樣式合成引擎之外,Nopia 還內建 delay(延遲)、reverb(殘響)、磁帶模擬與 beat repeat 等基本效果,並提供大量連接選項,包括各模組獨立的 MIDI 輸出,讓使用者能用 Nopia 的和聲引擎去控制其他樂器。
